verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not mention multi-currency invoicing, per-currency price lists, exchange rates, or home-currency consolidated reporting. Related items such as 10+ language support, worldwide payment gateways and generic payment-pattern reports are adjacent features and do not show this capability. The axis clearly applies to an invoicing product, so the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
